s: Din hattepilla beereb shabbat ubo v' seipim: nohagin shello lippol al penehem achar tepillat mincha beereb shabbat:

Venohagim lehaqdim tepillat arbit yoter mibbimot hachol. Venakon hu, kede lehaqdim qabbalat shabbat bekol mah sheepshar, raq sheyyehe mippelag hammincha ulemala, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"a veras"g. Veap hammitpalelin arbit bizmannah betzet hakkokabim kol yemot hachol — yakol hu lehaqdim beereb shabbat lehitpallel mippelag hammincha ulemala, kedibre rabbi yehuda sheomer shemmippelag hammincha veelak hu layla leinyan tepilla. Veap shellipamim bishar yamim mitpallel mincha bizman hahu, vahare hen shette qullot hassoterot zo et zo kemo shennitbaer besimman ral"[g] — en chosheshim lazeh bitpillat arbit shel shabbat, sheyyesh mitzva keshemmitpallel otah mibbeod yom shemmosip mechol al haqqodesh. Ella shetztzarik hu lizzaher shello lehitpallel mincha bo bayyom atzmo achar pelag hammincha, shello yaaseh b' qullot hassoterot zo et zo bizman echad. Vegam tzarik lizzaher liqrot qeriat shema, kemo shennitbaer besimman rl"h. Veyakol hu gam ken liqrotah ballayla im birkoteha, umibbeod yom yitpallel hattepila shel shabbat bilbad belo qeriat shema ubirkoteha. Veap sheeno somek geulla litpilla — en bekak kelum, kevan shemmitkavven lemitzva lehosip mechol al haqqodesh. Umikkol maqom, im rotzeh lehitpallel gam hattepilla shel shabbat ballayla — hareshut beyado, veyosip mechol al haqqodesh belo tepilla. Veap hammitpallel arbit mibbeod yom — yakol leqabbel tosepet shabbat qodem tepilla:

Keshem sheameru leinyan tepilla — kak ameru leinyan qiddush hayyom, sheyyakol leqaddesh veleekol mippelag hammincha ulemala apillu im lo hitpallel arbit adayin. Ubaakila zo shemmibbeod yom yotze yede chobat seudda achat mig' seuddot shechayyab leekol beshabbat (kevan shekkebar qibbel alayv tosepet shabbat — naasa etzlo keshabbat atzmah lekol dabar). Veyesh machmirim sheyyamshik seuddato ballayla atzmo, sheyyokal kezayit lepachot achar tzet hakkokabim, kede sheyyeqayyem g' seuddot beshabbat atzmah, dekevan sheg' seuddot ellu lamdum chakamim mimmah shenneemar g' peamim "hayyom" etzel akilat hamman beshabbat, lepikak tzarik leoklan beitztzumah shel yom velo betosapto. Vetob lachush ledibrehem:

(Hammitpallel arbit bizmannah kol yemot hachol ubeereb shabbat mitpallel mibbeod yom) (ap al pi sheqqara gam qeriat shema) — asur lo lehatchil leekol kachatzi shaa samuk letzet hakkokabim (ella im ken hu sheat haddechaq) (sheyyikbu hannerot ad hallayla), kemo shennitbaer besimman rl"h (shehare hu lo yatza yede chobato kelal biqriat shema sheqqara mibbeod yom):

Bebirkat "hashkibenu" lo yachtom "shomer ammo yisrael" kemo bechol, sheen yisrael tzerikin shemira beshabbat, shehashshabbat meginna alenu, ella kevan shehiggia le"ubetzel kenapeka tastirenu" — yomar "uperos sukkat ku', baruk atta Hashem happores ku'". Ubimdinot ellu nohagin lomar gam ken "ki el shomerenu ku', ushemor tzetenu ku'" kemo bechol, vechotemim "uperos ku', baruk atta Hashem happores ku'", lepi sheharabbim hem sheenam tzerikin shemira beshabbat, abal hayyachid tzarik shemira, lepikak en chotemim "shomer ammo yisrael", shekkelalut am yisrael enam tzerikin shemira beshabbat, abal kesheomerim "ushemor tzetenu", mebaqshim bazeh al kol yachid veyachid:

Hannohagin lomar "veshameru bene yisrael et hashshabbat ku'" — yesh lahem al mah sheyyismoku. Veen zeh hepseq ben geulla litpilla, lepi sheim shameru yisrael shette shabbatot miyyad nigalin, vahare zeh meen geulla gam ken:
